sourceDate.text: 昭王薨，安釐王即位，封公子為信陵君
日夜為樂飲者四歲，竟病酒而卒
秦兵圍大梁，破魏華陽下軍
范睢亡魏相秦，以怨魏齊故
秦聞公子死，使蒙驁攻魏
十八歲而虜魏王，屠大梁

translationRepairs: He picked eight thousand of the best troops and marched against the Qin army.
He selected eighty thousand of the best troops and marched against the Qin army.
Chinese 八萬人 is eighty thousand troops; idiomatic “eight thousand” understates the figure by a factor of ten, and “eighty thousand” restores the correct numeral without distorting the sentence.
He selected eight thousand elite troops and advanced to attack the Qin army.
He selected eighty thousand elite troops and advanced to attack the Qin army.
The same 八萬人 appears in the literal English as “eight thousand”; correcting to “eighty thousand” matches the Chinese numeral while leaving the rest of the calque intact.
